plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} worked hard, complained a little, and never once left someone behind. That's more than most of us can say.
I don't have the right words. {OTHER_nameDef} would have. That's the problem.
Every wall here has a little of {OTHER_nameDef} in it. We'll keep them standing.
{OTHER_nameDef} was here, with us. On the rim, that's everything.
[longtime] {YEARS} years. {OTHER_nameDef} was here for {YEARS} years. Most of what we have, {OTHER_nameDef} helped build.
[titled] We called {OTHER_nameDef} {TITLE}. It wasn't a joke. It was earned, every day.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL}. Didn't get the time. Some of us will try to finish it.
[battle] {FACTION} did this. {OTHER_nameDef} stood on the wall so the rest of us didn't have to. We won't forget that, and we won't forget them.
[battle] {OTHER_nameDef} died holding the line. Every one of us is alive because the line held.
[deadchild] There's nothing to say about a child in the ground. Nothing that helps. We'll remember the laughing.
[deadold] {OTHER_nameDef} saw more winters than any of us. Taught us how to get through them, too.
[kin] {OTHER_nameDef} was my family. Out here, family is the only thing you can't replace.
[partner] I woke up every day next to {OTHER_nameDef}. I don't know how to wake up any other way.
[stranger] I didn't know {OTHER_nameDef} well. I wish I had. That's the worst thing I can say, and it's true.
[rival] {OTHER_nameDef} and I fought about everything. I'd give a lot for one more argument.
[winter] We buried {OTHER_nameDef} in frozen ground. It took all of us. {OTHER_nameDef} would have liked that.
[rain] Even the sky is crying for {OTHER_nameDef}. Fitting. {OTHER_nameDef} was always dramatic.
{OTHER_nameDef} never asked for much. A warm bed, a hot meal, a little peace. We should have been able to give more than that.
Some people make a colony work. {OTHER_nameDef} made it worth working for.
[stranger] I'm told {OTHER_nameDef} was good with the animals and hated mornings. That's all I know. I wish I'd asked for more.
[stranger] Somebody closer should be standing here, but nobody closer could get the words out. So: {OTHER_nameDef} was one of us, and we're less without {OTHER_objective}.
[rival] I never liked {OTHER_nameDef}, and {OTHER_nameDef} never liked me. I'd still have trusted {OTHER_objective} with my life, and I think the feeling was mutual.
[rival] Half the arguments in this colony were between {OTHER_nameDef} and me. It's going to be very quiet now. I hate that.
[kin] Same blood. Same stubborn chin. I'll see {OTHER_nameDef} every time I catch my reflection in the water.
[partner] We had plans. Small ones. A garden, a dog, a quiet old age. I'll keep the garden going.
[battle] {OTHER_nameDef} didn't have to be on that wall. {OTHER_nameDef} chose to be. Remember that, when you remember anything.
[battle] {FACTION} came at us, and {OTHER_nameDef} met them at the gate. Every breath we take today is owed to that.
[deadchild] {OTHER_nameDef} should have grown up here. Should have been bored here, and fallen in love here, and complained about chores. We'll have to carry all of that now.
[deadold] {OTHER_nameDef} told the same three stories every winter. I'd give anything to hear them again. I'll tell them myself, badly.
[titled] We called {OTHER_nameDef} {TITLE}, and nobody ever had to ask why.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} was going to {GOAL}. Was going to. I'll carry that the rest of the way, if I can.
[longtime] {OTHER_nameDef} was here before most of us. {YEARS} years of mornings, and every one of them counted.
[night] We're burying {OTHER_nameDef} by torchlight, because none of us could bear to wait for morning. Nobody wanted {OTHER_objective} out there alone tonight.
[summer] It's a beautiful day. {OTHER_nameDef} would have been out in the fields in it, complaining about the heat.
[old] I've buried too many people younger than me. {OTHER_nameDef} is one more. I'm tired of the arithmetic.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made this place a home. Not a camp, not a fort. A home. Thank you, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[partner] I loved {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm going to keep saying it, out loud, so the rim knows.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL}. I'm going to try, for {OTHER_nameDef}.
I hope wherever {OTHER_nameDef} is now, it's warm and the food is good and nobody needs anything. Rest. You earned it.
[partner] Every good thing I am, I learned from loving {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll keep being those things. It's all I can do.
[deadchild] Little {OTHER_nameDef}. You were the best of us, and you never even knew it.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was good at the job and good to the people around. Not much more to say. Not much more that matters.
[battle] {FACTION} took {OTHER_nameDef}. Next time they come, they'll find out what that cost them.
[rival] We didn't get on. Everyone knows it. {OTHER_nameDef} was still one of ours, and I'll fight anyone who says different.
{OTHER_nameDef} worked. {OTHER_nameDef} fought. {OTHER_nameDef} didn't quit. That's a life.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made me laugh every single day. I'm going to try to keep doing that for all of you. It won't be as good.
{OTHER_nameDef} would hate all this crying. So let's tell the one about {OTHER_nameDef} and the muffalo and the latrine instead. Everyone knows the one.
[longtime] {YEARS} years of terrible jokes from {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm going to miss every single one. Especially the worst ones.

gloomy.li: We're all heading where {OTHER_nameDef} has gone. {OTHER_nameDef} just got there first, and left us the work.
[deadchild] We were supposed to keep the children safe. That was the whole point of all of this.
[lowmood] I don't have anything comforting to say. {OTHER_nameDef} is gone, and the rim doesn't care. So we'll have to. That's all.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL}, and the rim said no. It always says no, in the end.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was reliable. Competent. Irreplaceable, in the literal sense. We are weaker today.
[battle] {OTHER_nameDef} fell to {FACTION}. I've added that to the ledger.
{OTHER_nameDef}'s duties will be reassigned by morning. {OTHER_nameDef} will not be replaced. Those are different things.
[titled] We called {OTHER_nameDef} {TITLE}. The title stays in the annals. The person doesn't. I find that unacceptable.
